about: Shared cases for the two previews of py-doc Markdown: the VS Code instant preview (editors/vscode/test/test.js) and the HTML twin that --watch builds with pandoc (tests/test_preview_cases.py). Both must find what each case expects, so the instant preview cannot drift from the build. 'command' is also what the VS Code extension must detect for the case.

cases.name: callouts in both spellings
cases.markdown:
# Installing

> [!WARNING]
> Disconnect the battery first.

> **Tip:** Keep the screws.

> [!NOTE]
> Firmware 2 or later.
